_comment: Leaguewide rate splits by (batter_hand, pitcher_hand). 'RvL' means right-handed batter vs left-handed pitcher. Switch hitters resolve to opposite-of-pitcher in code. Values are approximate published 2024-2025 leaguewide splits (FanGraphs/Statcast); refine in Phase 4 by computing from the full Statcast season once that backfill lands.
